content_record.title: FARS-1/FARSA: A tRNA Synthetase That Silences Mitochondrial dsRNAs to Extend Lifespan
content_record.editorial_body: A moonlighting enzyme suppresses immunogenic mitochondrial double-stranded RNAs, balancing longevity and innate immunity in worms and human cells. Three things to remember - Mitochondrial dsRNAs accumulate with age and trigger aberrant immune activation. - FARS-1/FARSA binds dsRNAs via a novel domain, reducing their levels. - Inhibiting FARS-1 boosts immunity but may trade off longevity. Source This signal is based on Phenylalanyl-tRNA synthetase FARS-1/FARSA balances longevity and immunity by downregulating endogenous mitochondrial double-stranded RNAs. from PubMed. Read the original report for full context. Health note: Findings in C. elegans and cultured human cells; human translation unproven.
